body:
Someone writes the resignation letter in a single afternoon.

They convert years of silence into one irreversible act, the quit, the move-out, the post everyone can see, and the exit runs on stored fuel.

With Uranus conjunct Lilith, the same person supplies the sudden break and the long-banned reason for it.

So they take their freedom all at once instead of by degrees.

The liberation may be correct while the timing and the exit speech still deserve a day of thought.
